note: Background, bond, ideal, and flaw change reactions and available lines. They are not combat classes and they grant no meters.

backgrounds.label: Intervale
backgrounds.detail: Raised on flood-ground farming in the New Haven or Cornwall flats.

backgrounds.label: Mill race
backgrounds.detail: Raised within earshot of a wheel on Otter Creek.

backgrounds.label: Quarry cut
backgrounds.detail: Raised with limestone in the clothes, Bristol or the hills above it.

backgrounds.label: Crossing
backgrounds.detail: Raised at a landing, a bell, or a toll.

backgrounds.label: Survey desk
backgrounds.detail: Raised around maps, oaths, and the habit of a fair copy.

backgrounds.label: Roadside
backgrounds.detail: Raised at a pullout, a stand, a pump, a bench that faces traffic.

bonds.label: Harrow homestead
bonds.detail: You answer first when the orchard is spoken of.

bonds.label: Voss crossing
bonds.detail: You answer first when the landing log is wrong.

bonds.label: Demerritt wheel
bonds.detail: You answer first when the gate moves.

bonds.label: Waite house
bonds.detail: You answer first when a plate is set for someone who is not coming.

bonds.label: Pellegrin cut
bonds.detail: You answer first when a name is about to be rained off.

bonds.label: Lamb stand
bonds.detail: You answer first when an order is about to be corrected.

bonds.label: Unbound
bonds.detail: No house has a first claim. People notice the lack.

ideals.label: The record holds
ideals.detail: A thing written in the book is the thing that happened, or it must be made so.

ideals.label: The living first
ideals.detail: A living inconvenience outranks a correct sentence.

ideals.label: Names aloud
ideals.detail: A name unspoken is a wage unpaid.

ideals.label: Water has its level
ideals.detail: You do not argue with where water wants to go. You argue with who is standing there.

flaws.label: Spares a kind lie
flaws.detail: You will not correct a mercy that is also inaccurate.

flaws.label: Signs unread
flaws.detail: Your hand will sign to end a silence.

flaws.label: Keeps a second copy
flaws.detail: You cannot stand one record. You make another, and then a third problem.

flaws.label: Cannot leave a gate
flaws.detail: An unlatched gate, a half-told sentence, an open sack: you will finish it even when finishing is the harm.
